d:
Pawapuri Jal Mandir Bihar ka ek aisa adbhut aur shant mandir hai jo pani ke beech bana hua hai. Nalanda district me sthit ye mandir Jain dharm ke liye bahut pavitra mana jata hai. Kaha jata hai ki isi jagah Bhagwan Mahavir ne nirvana prapt kiya tha.
Is video me hum jaanenge Pawapuri Jal Mandir ka itihaas, Mahavir connection, pani ke beech mandir banne ka rahasya, hidden facts, architecture, Bihar tourism aur Delhi se Pawapuri kaise pahunche — sab kuch detail me.
